question: How many paid vacation days do I get each year?
reference_answer: Permanent employees get 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year; mid-year joiners get 2 days per full month remaining.

question: Can unused annual leave roll over into next year?
reference_answer: Yes, up to 5 unused days carry over and must be used by 31 March; days above 5 expire on 31 December and are not paid out.

question: I was off sick for three days. Do I need a doctor's note?
reference_answer: Yes. For more than 2 consecutive days of sick leave you must upload a medical certificate to OrbitHR within 3 days of returning.

question: How long is parental leave for the primary caregiver?
reference_answer: 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave, which can start up to 2 weeks before the expected birth or adoption.

question: How much bereavement leave do I get if my grandmother passes away?
reference_answer: 2 days of paid bereavement leave for relatives outside the immediate family (5 days for immediate family).

question: What's the maximum I can spend per night on a hotel in London?
reference_answer: London is a high-cost city, so the nightly hotel limit is USD 260 (USD 180 in standard cities), booked through OrbitTravel.

question: What is the daily food allowance when I travel abroad for work?
reference_answer: USD 95 per day for international travel (USD 75 domestic); alcohol is not reimbursable except pre-approved client dinners.

question: How long do I have to submit an expense claim?
reference_answer: Within 30 days of the expense date in OrbitExpense; claims submitted after 90 days are rejected.

question: Do I need a receipt for a 20 dollar taxi ride?
reference_answer: No. Itemised receipts are required only for expenses above USD 25.

question: A supplier wants to send me a 100 dollar gift basket. Can I accept it?
reference_answer: Gifts above USD 50 per supplier per year must be declared in the Gifts Register within 5 working days and approved by your manager; cash or gift cards are never allowed.

question: Is there an allowance for my home internet if I work from home?
reference_answer: Yes, USD 30 per month paid with salary for employees who work from home at least 2 days per week.

question: How many days a year can I work remotely from another country?
reference_answer: Up to 20 working days per calendar year, with manager approval and an HR tax check submitted at least 10 working days before travel.

question: My VPN says VPN-809 when I'm on hotel wifi. What do I do?
reference_answer: VPN-809 means the gateway is unreachable. Check the internet connection, turn off any third-party VPN, and switch to the 'TCP 443 fallback' profile because hotel Wi-Fi often blocks the VPN port.

question: I got a new phone and the MFA push notifications stopped coming.
reference_answer: Raise an IT ticket with category 'MFA re-enrolment'; the Service Desk must verify your identity.

question: What are the password length and expiry rules?
reference_answer: At least 14 characters, no reuse of the last 10 passwords, and passwords expire every 180 days.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
reference_answer: Go to reset.orbit.example, enter your Orbit email, verify with OrbitAuth or the code sent to your registered phone, and choose a new password; it works everywhere within 15 minutes.

question: Someone stole my work laptop from my car. What should I do?
reference_answer: Report it within 1 hour by raising a High priority ticket in category Security; IT will remotely wipe it and you need a police report number.

question: My laptop keeps crashing with stop code 0x0000007E.
reference_answer: It is usually an outdated driver: restart and install all pending driver updates from Company Portal > Updates; if it happens more than twice a week raise a Hardware ticket with the stop code.

question: What is the response time target for a P2 incident?
reference_answer: 1 hour response target and 8 hours resolution target.

question: How do I get software that isn't in Company Portal?
reference_answer: Raise an IT ticket with category 'Software Request' including name, version, business reason and licence cost; your manager approves it and IT Security reviews it within 5 working days.

question: By when do new joiners have to finish their mandatory training?
reference_answer: Within 30 days of joining; incomplete training blocks access to production systems.

question: My account got locked after too many failed VPN logins. How long is the lockout and can I unlock it myself?
reference_answer: After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes; you can wait or unlock it immediately at reset.orbit.example using MFA.

question: As a new hire, when can I start working from home and what equipment allowance do I get?
reference_answer: After completing the 90-day probation period; eligible employees get a one-time USD 400 home office allowance claimed within 6 months.

question: I lost my laptop with customer data on it. How fast must I report it and what priority does a security incident get?
reference_answer: Report within 1 hour with a High priority Security ticket; suspected data leaks are always treated as P1 incidents.

question: Can I paste customer documents into an AI tool that isn't approved?
reference_answer: No. Unapproved AI tools that upload company data are prohibited, and confidential information must not be pasted into unapproved AI tools.

question: What do I need to set up in my first week regarding MFA and VPN?
reference_answer: Set up OrbitAuth MFA with IT on Day 1, and in week 1 set up the VPN and test it from home, plus complete Security Awareness and Code of Conduct training.

question: What about on a Mac?

history.content: How do I install the VPN client on Windows?
Open Company Portal, search for OrbitConnect and click Install, then restart [vpn-setup, 2.1 Windows].

standalone: How do I install the OrbitConnect VPN client on macOS?
reference_answer: Install OrbitConnect from Self Service and allow the system extension in System Settings > Privacy & Security.

question: And what about meals?

USD 180 per night in standard cities and USD 260 in high-cost cities [travel-reimbursement, 2.2 Hotels].

standalone: What is the meal allowance on business trips?
reference_answer: USD 75 per day domestic and USD 95 per day international.

question: And for a P3?

history.content: What is the response target for a P1 incident?
15 minutes response and 4 hours resolution [incident-escalation, 1. Priority Levels].

standalone: What is the response target for a P3 incident?
reference_answer: 4 hours response and 3 working days resolution.

question: How long until the new one works on the VPN?

history.content: I forgot my password, how do I reset it?
Go to reset.orbit.example and verify with OrbitAuth [password-reset, 2.2 When You Forgot Your Password].

standalone: After resetting my password, how long until the new password works on the VPN?
reference_answer: The new password works everywhere, including the VPN, within 15 minutes.
